hooks.text: If planning content every single morning is draining your creative energy, here is a simple weekly framework.
Stop brainstorming every day from scratch. Here is how to plan your entire week in three concrete steps.
Here is the exact three-step system you can use to batch plan a week of content in one sitting.

sections.heading: Hook
sections.text: Stop brainstorming every day from scratch. Here is how to plan your entire week in three concrete steps.

sections.heading: Step 1: Theme Your Days
sections.text: Step one: Assign themes to your posting days. For example, make Mondays educational breakdowns, Wednesdays behind-the-scenes, and Fridays audience questions. Themes narrow your focus immediately.

sections.heading: Step 2: Collect Prompts into a Central Backlog
sections.text: Step two: Maintain a single backlog doc for raw ideas. Spend twenty focused minutes reviewing your comments, bookmarks, and everyday notes, turning them into one-sentence concepts under each theme.

sections.heading: Step 3: Outline Formats Before Recording
sections.text: Step three: Draft bullet points for each concept before opening your camera or design app. Define the hook, the core takeaway, and the format so production becomes purely execution.

sections.heading: Outro & CTA
sections.text: Try scheduling one planning block this weekend to set up your next week. Save this Reel to reference when you plan!

payload.title: 3 Practical Steps to Batch Plan Content Weekly
